whole_system_comparison: Linux C++/OpenCV4.8.1 versus Windows Python/OpenCV5.0; no isolated kernel/language attribution.
group_definition: Medians of each arm for three-seed groups; single measured run otherwise. Percentage reductions are ratios of these medians, not confidence intervals or median paired effects.
memory_scope: Native child peak RSS, baseline recorded sampled peak memory when available. Neither is whole-system RAM/VRAM. Blank means unavailable.
end_to_end_fps_scope: Original frames divided by measured whole-dispatch wall including finalization. Not native-rate streaming acceptance.
full00_timing_limitation: Baseline completed before the diagnosed bootstrap-only pause; pause duration recorded. Source/runtime/input and randomized arm order unchanged, no favorable replay.
pose_scope: Online immutable emissions; ground truth evaluator-only; no frame exclusion/alignment scale fitting.
